description:
Create a new embedded Lightning wallet backed by the Spark SDK. Generates a fresh BIP39 mnemonic (shown once), encrypts it with the provided password, and stores it at ~/.aibtc/lightning/keystore.json. Returns the deposit address for funding the wallet from L1 BTC.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

password.description: Password to protect the Lightning wallet (minimum 8 characters) - WARNING: sensitive value

name: lightning_create
